isShortsByDuration returns true for durations up to and including 75 seconds (30, 60, 61, 75) and false from 76 seconds up (76, 110, 180, 600).

source.quote: isShortsByDuration — null defensively treated as shorts

obligations.statement: isShortsByDuration(null) returns true, so a video whose duration is unknown is treated as a short.
parseIsoDuration converts ISO 8601 durations to seconds: 'PT1M' gives 60, 'PT1H' gives 3600, 'PT1H2M3S' gives 3723 and 'PT45S' gives 45.
parseIsoDuration returns null for null, an empty string, 'garbage' and a bare 'PT'.

source.quote: titleIndicatesShorts — does NOT match the plain word "short"

obligations.statement: titleIndicatesShorts returns false for titles that only contain the plain word "short", such as 'A short book review' and 'short film director interview', and for an empty title.
titleHitsBlocklist matches blocked words regardless of case: it returns true for 'Best VLog of 2024' and '드라마 클립' and false for 'Korean grammar lesson'.
topicCategoryUrlToSlug drops a trailing parenthesised disambiguation and lowercases, so 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lifestyle_(sociology)' gives 'lifestyle'.
